note: The career's paddock press (track-viewer/src/game/career/media.js). 'images': press photos per driver, in track-viewer/public/assets/drivers/<slug>/media/<mood>.webp (portrait, win, down); a missing mood falls back to the portrait, then to the circuit. 'pairs': two-driver shots in drivers/pairs/. 'you': the player, never showing a face, in drivers/you/. 'principals': team principals by team id. 'scenes': shared scenes in drivers/scenes/. Every image has a -thumb.webp for tiles and bytes. scripts/make-driver-media.mjs rewrites these lists. 'quotes': invented lines in each driver's voice. 'social' and 'rumors': invented fan talk, with handle|text posts; fan anger stays on driving and results, and rumours are unconfirmed and never sexual. Provenance of the art: assets/career/MEDIA-IMAGES.md.

win: The plan worked. It usually does.
I saw this result around lap two.
down: A bad position. There will be another game.
I will study it tonight, then it is over.

win: Tonight Saetta sings, and I sing the loudest!
Tell Varrone I saved him a seat in the crowd.
down: Even the best opera has a bad act.
I smile anyway. You should see the other guy's lap times.

win: I brake later. That is the whole secret.
Whistle all you like. I heard you from the top step.
down: I apologise to no one, and I am not starting today.
Ask me after I have looked at who pushed whom.

win: They charged. I stepped aside. It is not complicated.
Do not call me La Torera. Call me the winner.
down: Patience costs you, some days.
The bull had a good afternoon. There are other afternoons.

win: Terribly sorry to everyone I passed. I shall write.
My grandfather would have enjoyed that one.
down: My apologies to the team. And to the barrier.
The note is already in the post.

win: Same lap as always. The others got slower.
No rush. Never was.
down: Bit of a slow one. Good surf next week, though.
You don't fix that by hurrying.

win: Grip is overrated.
It was sideways for most of it. That was the good part.
down: It stopped sliding. That was the problem.
Fine. Next.

win: Valois can keep his crown warm for me.
Tell the old guys I am only getting started.
down: One lap I have. Racecraft I am learning, okay?
I will be faster next time. Write that down.

win: A lovely afternoon, wouldn't you say?
Very kind of them all to leave me the room.
down: Even a champion may enjoy the view from further back.
Jazz helps. Ask me tomorrow, I shall be charming.

win: One does not hurry. One arrives.
Le Prince may have the photographs. I shall take the points.
down: A sigh will suffice.
The tyres were pristine. It is some comfort.

win: That's how we do it at the county fair.
Stewards can have the replay. I'm keeping the trophy.
down: Somebody hit me first. I'll check who later.
Put it on my tab with the stewards.

win: All waypoints nominal. Mission complete.
Flew the plan. Nothing further to report.
down: Deviation logged. We will review the checklist.
Not the flight plan I filed.

win: This one belongs to the whole Corniche.
Valois, I am coming for that crown.
down: I am sorry to everyone who stood up for me today.
A city's patience is long. Mine is shorter.

win: I lost count of the passes. Did you?
Desert roads are harder than this. And there, nobody waves a flag.
down: I ran out of people to pass. That never helps.
Tomorrow I smile again. Tonight, a little less.

win: The apex is a suggestion. Today it was a good one.
Kuroda will tell you it was murder on the tyres. She is right, and I won.
down: Too much angle. Maybe. Lindqvist will say so, loudly.
I bowed to the marshal who helped me out of the gravel.

win: Lap fourteen, four tenths. That was the race.
It is in the logbook.
down: Two tenths on entry. It is in the logbook.
There is nothing to say that the numbers have not said.

win: The car did what the data said it would. So did I.
We changed the rear wing by one click on Friday. That was the race.
down: I read it wrong on the cool-down lap, and I read it wrong before that.
The set-up was mine. So is this result.

win: Good.
Sauna now.
down: Not good.
Lindqvist will enjoy this. Let her.

love.title: The fans have picked a favourite: {who}
love.body: After the {gp} the feeds belong to {who}. Somebody has already made the scarf.
posts: @paddock_daily|{who} for president of everything.
@grandstand_gran|I am 74 and I have a new favourite driver. Sorry, husband.

love.title: {who} is having a moment online
love.body: The clip from the {gp} has gone round the world twice. The comments are unusually kind.
posts: @lap_one_louis|Watched that overtake nine times. Late for work. Worth it.
@{team}_ultras|Ours. All ours. Do not touch.

love.title: Love letters for {who}
love.body: The {team} mailroom has asked for a second bin.
posts: @apex_annie|Name a better driver. You cannot. I will wait.
@wet_tyre_wally|Cried at a racing result again. Normal week.

hate.title: {who} gets it from the fans after the {gp}
hate.body: The comments under {team}'s post were closed within the hour. The screenshots were not.
posts: @{team}_ultras|My nan brakes later than that.
@lap_one_louis|Sell the driver, keep the mechanic.

hate.title: Boos for {who}
hate.body: The result at the {gp} did not land well, and the grandstand said so before the car had stopped.
posts: @grandstand_gran|I paid for a race. I got a slow parade.
@paddock_daily|{team} deserve better than that, and they know it.

hate.title: "Drop {who}" is trending
hate.body: Three hours after the {gp}, the {team} faithful have opinions on the seat, and they are not shy about them.
posts: @apex_annie|Week {week}, and still looking for the first good lap.
@wet_tyre_wally|Bring back literally anyone.

war.title: Fan war: {team} against {rival}
war.body: It started with a replay of the {gp} and has now reached the supporters' clubs, who have taken it extremely seriously.
posts: @{team}_ultras|Clean move. Learn the rules, {rival}.
@{rival}_ultras|Watch it again, in slow motion, with your eyes open.

war.title: The {team} and {rival} stands have stopped pretending
war.body: Two sets of flags, one fence and a long afternoon. Security describes the singing as "inventive".
posts: @{rival}_ultras|We were louder. We were faster. Next.
@{team}_ultras|Your whole team fits in our garage. Polite wave.

leak.title: Who was at the {rival} motorhome?
leak.body: A grainy photo from the {gp} paddock shows a hooded figure leaving by the back door. {team} say they have no idea who it is. They have asked twice.
posts: @paddock_daily|That is {who}'s walk. I would know that walk anywhere.
@lap_one_louis|Contract talks in a hoodie. Cinema.

leak.title: Is {who} on the way out?
leak.body: Nobody at {team} will say it out loud after the {gp}, and that is what has people talking.
posts: @apex_annie|Three sources. All of them my cousin. Still.
@{team}_ultras|If this is true we riot. Politely.

rumors.title: Calderini and Varrone: just dinner?
rumors.body: A long-lens photo from a lakeside restaurant has the whole paddock looking at its phone. Former teammates, current rivals, one small table. Neither camp confirms a thing, and one of them calls it "a dinner".
posts: @paddock_daily|She out-qualified him for a year. Of course he is in love.
@apex_annie|That is not how you look at someone you are racing on Sunday.

rumors.title: Kareem and Qasimi: the marina is talking
rumors.body: Two teammates, one sunset and a photographer on a very long lens. Both say they were discussing tyre strategy. Nobody has ever laughed that hard about tyre strategy.
posts: @corniche_kid|I have stood up for them both. I will stand up for this.
@lap_one_louis|"Friendly rivalry that splits the crowd." Sure.

rumors.title: Lindqvist and Mizuno, seen arguing over noodles
rumors.body: Two seasons of bickering about who is better sideways, and now a late-night photo on a bench. She says it was an argument. He says it was a great argument.
posts: @wet_tyre_wally|They are either dating or solving physics.
@grandstand_gran|I have seen this film. It ends with a wedding.

rumors.title: Who was {me} with at the marina?
rumors.body: A grainy photo after the {gp} has the gossip columns guessing. {team} will only say that drivers are allowed to go for walks.
posts: @paddock_daily|That is definitely {me}. Who is the other one, though?
@apex_annie|{me} has a whole life and did not tell us. Rude.

life.note: Off-track stories (media.js coverLife), keyed by item id or event. Tokens: {me}, {team}, {brand}, {item}. kind life reads as Ultrack Wire, scandal as Paddock Whispers. Light and dry; never about driving after a drink, never about anyone's body.

stories.title: {me} gets the keys to a city apartment
stories.body: A view of the skyline and, for the first time, a fridge nobody else has opened. {team}'s garage is a short drive away.

stories.title: {me} moves into a penthouse
stories.body: Top floor, a private lift and a neighbour who has already complained about the helmets in the hall.

stories.title: {me} buys the big house
stories.body: Gates, a garden and a garage with room for the trophies. The paddock is calling it the winner's address.

stories.title: A new watch for {me}
stories.body: A serious one with a serious price. The pit wall has asked whether it can be used to time laps.

stories.title: {me} takes delivery of a supercar
stories.body: Quicker than most road cars and, the garage points out, a lot slower than the race car. It stays parked on race weekends.

stories.title: {me} has bought a yacht
stories.body: Moored in the harbour with a crew of six and a flag nobody recognises. The whole paddock is angling for an invitation.

stories.title: A night out for {me}
stories.body: Friends, a table at the back and no photographers. At least, that was the plan.

stories.title: {me} throws a party
stories.body: Half the paddock turned up and the other half heard about it by morning.

stories.title: {me}'s party is the talk of the Tour
stories.body: A hired hall, a band and a guest list that kept {team}'s press officer busy until sunrise.

stories.title: {me} caught up in a party row
stories.body: Pictures from the night reached the feeds before {me} did. {team} says it is aware of them and would like to move on.

stories.title: Neighbours complain about {me}'s party
stories.body: Noise, a visit from the local officers asking for the music to be turned down, and a short statement from {team}: drivers are allowed a life, a quieter one ideally.

stories.title: {brand} unhappy with {me}'s night out
stories.body: The brand's logo was in too many of the pictures. They have asked for a word, and have been told {me} is listening.

stories.title: {me} takes a week off
stories.body: Somewhere warm, with the phone off. {team} insists the car will not notice.

stories.title: {me} is away on a luxury break
stories.body: Seven days of sun and no timing screens. The engineers admit they are enjoying the quiet as well.

stories.title: {me} spends a day with the fans
stories.body: Autographs, selfies and a lap of the car park in a team van. The queue was longer than anyone planned for.

stories.title: {me} hosts a charity gala
stories.body: A night of auctions for a good cause. The signed helmet went for more than anybody guessed.

stories.title: {me} fronts a {brand} shoot
stories.body: A day in front of the lights. The photographer called it a natural. The driver called it a long day.

stories.title: {me} is on the billboards
stories.body: {brand} has put the driver's face on a wall across the Tour. The fans are already adding moustaches.

stories.title: {brand} cast {me} in a new advert
stories.body: Thirty seconds on prime-time television and three days of takes. {me} says the car was easier.

stories.title: {me} is on top of the world
stories.body: Results, a happy garage and a grandstand that sings the driver's name. Nobody in the paddock has seen {me} this relaxed.

stories.title: Is {me} still happy at {team}?
stories.body: The body language says no. {team} says everything is fine, in a tone that suggests otherwise.

stories.title: {me} wants out
stories.body: The driver has told {team} that a move is the only way forward. The team says it will not stand in the way.

stories.title: {me} sells the {item}
stories.body: The running costs caught up with the plan, and the {item} went back on the market.

rep: {team} know the name: reputation {rep}, where their bar is {gate}.
Your name carries in the paddock now, and {team} have heard it: reputation {rep}.
{team} want a driver people talk about. At {rep} reputation, that is you.
rating: Your rounds rate {rr} on average, over the {bar} {team} ask for.
{team} like the numbers: an average round rating of {rr}.
An average round rating of {rr} clears the {bar} {team} look for.
form: {team} have watched your last three rounds, and liked them.
You are in form, and {team} noticed.
Your recent rounds are the best of your season, and {team} want them in their car.

callbacks.note: Lines that quote the career's ledger back (media.js callbackOf, from ledger.latest): offer is an outside offer's reason or a cool team's line, principal the team principal's story at the season-end market, rival the feud story after a race. {who} is the driver in the entry, {me} the player, {team} and {principal} its team, {season} the season it happened in.

spurned: {team} have not forgotten you walked out of talks in Season {season}.
{team} remember Season {season}, when you walked out of talks with them.
callout_won: They saw you answer {who}'s callout in Season {season}.
You beat {who} after they called you out in Season {season}, and it was noticed.
bold_press: They liked what you said about {who} in Season {season}.
Your words about {who} in Season {season} are still quoted.
orders_obeyed: They know you let {who} through when {team} asked, in Season {season}.
orders_ignored: They know you kept your place against {team}'s orders in Season {season}.

orders_obeyed: {principal}, on the season: "When we asked for {who}, the place was given. That is a team driver."
"We asked once, and it was done," {principal} said of the team order with {who}.
orders_ignored: {principal}, on the season: "We asked for one thing, one place for {who}, and did not get it. We have not forgotten."
"Team orders are not a suggestion," {principal} said, still thinking of {who}.

callout_won: {who} called {me} out in Season {season}, and lost that one.
This goes back to the callout {who} lost in Season {season}.
callout_lost: {who} won the callout in Season {season}, and has not let anyone forget it.
bold_press: It has been personal since the press conference in Season {season}.
orders_ignored: It goes back to the team order that was ignored in Season {season}.

title: {driver}'s seat at {team} is up for renewal
{team}: {driver} is up for renewal
Who drives for {team} next season? {driver} is up for renewal
body: {driver}'s contract with {team} runs out at the end of the season. The paddock shortlist: {list}.
{team} have not re-signed {driver} yet, and the names in the paddock are {list}.
With {driver} up for renewal, {team} are said to be looking at {list}.

window.note: The season-end transfer window and the principals' styles (offers.js talksFor, transfers.js; docs/career-mode.md 6.10). {principal}, {team}, {other} (the other team), {rival} (a driver), {me} (the player) are filled in. Nothing here mentions how attached a driver is to a team: that stays hidden.

read.hardball: Plays hardball: little patience, short deadlines.
read.warm: Warm: patient, and open to a real conversation.
read.bidder: A bidder: pays to win a driver, and hates to lose one.
read.frugal: Frugal: watches every coin, and patient enough to haggle.

prize.hardball: They give nothing away: every term costs the same.
prize.warm: They give most on the contract length: a shorter deal costs you half as much.
prize.bidder: They give most on salary: a raise costs you half as much.
prize.frugal: They give most on the signing bonus and status: those cost you half as much.

up: {other} can pay what they like. Our number stands.
I do not bid against anyone. Take it or go.
down: {other} pay less than we do. Do not waste my time.
You think I cannot read a contract? We are done playing.
meet: I don't do coffee. Say what you want.
deadline: Fine. This is final. Sign it today or forget us.
rival: You wanted an answer today. You have it: we signed {rival}.

up: {other} rate you that highly? Then so do we. Let us close the gap.
We will not lose you over money. Here is more.
down: {other} offer less than we do, and we both know it. Let us be honest with each other.
meet: Come by the motorhome. I want to know what makes you tick, and you should know what matters to us.
deadline: You want it settled today? Then these are the best terms I can give. Final.
rival: I am sorry. We could not wait, and {rival} signed this morning.
want: That means a lot here. Take your time, we are not going anywhere.

up: Nobody outbids us for a driver we want.
down: {other} offer less than we do. Nice try.
meet: Lunch is on us. We are here to win, and we pay for winners.
deadline: Today, then. Our best terms, final. We do not lose drivers to deadlines.
rival: We needed an answer. {rival} gave us one.
want: Then sign. We will make it worth it.

up: {other} are generous. We can move a little, not all the way.
Half the gap. That is as far as the budget goes.
down: {other} pay less than we do. We checked.
meet: Coffee, yes. Lunch is a budget line. Let me tell you where we can bend.
deadline: If it must be today: this is everything the budget allows. Final.
rival: {rival} was cheaper and said yes. We have signed them.
want: Good. Wanting to be here is worth more than a bonus to us.

stay: {principal}: "We heard about {other}. You are not going anywhere if we can help it."
{principal}: "Talk to whoever you like. Then look at this."
go: {principal}: "If {other} want you that much, they can have you."
raise: {team} come back with more: {coins} a round.
{team} raise their offer to {coins} a round.

title: {me} seen with {team}
Talks: {me} and {team}
{team} want {me}, says the paddock
body: {me} was spotted at the {team} motorhome, and nobody is denying talks.
The paddock says {team} have made {me} an offer. Neither side will comment.

sack: {principal}: "The results were not good enough. We need more from that car."
{principal}: "It is a hard call, and the right one. We move on."
bitter: {principal}: "After everything we gave {rival}? Some drivers forget who made them."
{principal}: "They paid the fee. Let them find out what they bought."

divisions.note: The two series (media.js coverSwap, coverChampions, coverGiantKill; career.js inbox lines). {elite} and {challenger} are the series' names from tuning.json divisions.

up.title: {up} go up to the {elite}
up.body: Top of the {challenger} Teams' table, {up} race in the {elite} next season. {down} finish last in the Elite and go down.

youUp.title: You took {team} up
youUp.body: {team} top the {challenger} Teams' table and race in the {elite} next season, on the same cars. {down} go the other way.

youDown.title: {team} go down. Your contract stands.
youDown.body: Last in the {elite} Teams' table, {team} race in the {challenger} next season. {up} take their place. Any team that signs you buys you out.

giantKill.title: {who} beats the Elite at the {gp}
giantKill.body: P{place} at the {gp} from the {challenger}, ahead of {beat} Elite drivers.

start.challenger: Top the {challenger} Teams' table and {team} go up.
start.elite: Finish above the last team in the {elite} Teams' table and {team} stay up.

meanwhile.title: Meanwhile in the {other}
meanwhile.body: {winner} won at the {gp}. Top of the {other}: {leader}.

decided.title: The tables are settled
decided.body: {up} go up from the {challenger}, and {down} go down from the {elite}. {left} The cups score no series points.

review.title: {up} are promoted
review.body: {up} race in the {elite} next season. {down} go down to the {challenger}.
